text:
incident-bot: Pager alert triggered — router-tail-latency in us-west-2. p95 > 500ms, p99 > 2s, streaming stalls. Pager: @sam
sam (oncall): Ack. Investigating. Starting timeline.
lina (sre): I see a routing policy rollout around 02:10 UTC (rpolicy-77) that changed shard-weight heuristics. Could be related.
kevin (router eng): Telemetry shows heavy stickiness to shard-17 in us-west-2a. shard-17 CPU ~98% and queue depth spiking. Hash skew + warmup artifacts look likely.
maya (infra): Also seeing zone egress skew — us-west-2b routing table diverged briefly, seeds regenerated. Logs snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T02:12:34Z WARN routing: shard=shard-17 weight=0.92 seed=0x3f2a
2026-03-15T02:12:35Z INFO router: enqueued=812 queue_ms=1200
```
dave (support): Customer impact: CS reports elevated error rate on streaming endpoints. 3 enterprise tenants saw token delays + 504s. Top impacted: tenant-omega (about 11k failed reqs in last 5m).
sam (oncall): Priority: reduce p99 tail. Mitigation plan: 1) reweight shard-17 to 0.15 in us-west-2, 2) drain hot router instances, 3) rollback rpolicy-77 if reweight doesn't help. Executing reweight now.
kevin (router eng): Running command: 
```
routerctl --region us-west-2 reweight --shard shard-17 --weight 0.15 --reason "incident 2211122334"
```
ops-bot: Reweight task queued, roll id rw-202603150213
maya (infra): Draining node router-usw2a-17: `service routerd drain router-usw2a-17` — starting drain.
deploy-bot: Noted. Preparing canary rollback for rpolicy-77 -> rpolicy-76 (standby).
lina (sre): Monitoring p95/p99. Baseline at alert: p95=600ms, p99=2.3s. Targets: p95 <200ms, p99 <600ms.
sam (oncall): Update: reweight applied, queue depth falling. p95 down to ~280ms, p99 down to ~780ms. Progress but still above SLO.
kevin (router eng): Pushing soft-route fallback to redirect new connections off shard-17 while drains finish. Command: 
```
routerctl soft-route --from shard-17 --to shard-9,shard-12 --pct 100
```
lina (sre): p99 now ~520ms. Streaming stalls much less frequent. Observing continued hotkey fanout for tenant-omega — concentrated traffic pattern.
dave (support): CS: posting recovery note to affected tenants, keeping watch for regressions.
sam (oncall): Keeping rollback on standby. We'll monitor for 20m then decide.
kevin (router eng): Root cause hypothesis: interaction between rpolicy weight change + short routing-seed race + sudden hot key fanout concentrated load on shard-17. Will open postmortem with telemetry.
maya (infra): Added an alert to detect routing-seed divergence correlated with shard weight drift.
lina (sre): Handoff to kevin for follow-up postmortem and next-12h watch. @kevin you are on for rotation.
sam (oncall): Handoff ack. Thanks for the quick mitigation. Closing if stable in 35m :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: Incident update: mitigations applied rw-202603150213, drains started, rollback held. ticket #INC-2211122334
kevin (router eng): Saved routing-table snapshots and logs to s3://redwood-incidents/2211122334/ for postmortem.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed at 02:28 UTC — no adverse impact observed.
lina (sre): Final metrics at 02:40 UTC: p95=180ms, p99=310ms, streaming error rate back to baseline. Preparing postmortem. Closing thread after PM posted.
